covers: Traveler trip planner on the web: /trip-plan landing, /trip-plan/[id] plan page, BFF /bff/itineraries/**, unlock via inline card, refine/versions/PDF. Admin settings are in admin-dashboard-ui (/xtripplany).

files.client: TripPlanHome, TripPlanForm, TripPlanGenerating (Flight-loader Lottie), TripPlanList, TripPlanDocument, [id]/TripPlanDetail, [id]/TripPlanUnlock, [id]/TripPlanRefine

contract.backend: /api/itineraries (requireDevAuth): GET /config, GET /, POST / (2-5 min), GET/DELETE /:id, POST /:id/edit {prompt<=500} (long), GET /:id/versions/:n, GET /:id/pdf?version=n, POST /:id/checkout (requireRealEmail), POST /:id/provision {payment_id}
contract.price: show price.quoteAmount/quoteCurrency (what Pokpay charges), as mobile does

gotchas: Long calls need backendFetch timeoutMs (undici Agent) AND nginx proxy_read_timeout >= 600s on the Next location
Delete is only allowed for archived plans; the list only offers delete under Older plans
Edit response has no document: refetch GET /:id after editing
BFF validates [id] (^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$) and version (^\d{1,4}$) before interpolating into backend paths
Running `pnpm build` while `pnpm dev` is running shares .next and breaks the dev server (500s): restart dev afterwards
not_done: no web email-claim flow for real_email_required
